name: Redridge Goulash
summary: In Lakeshire, Redridge Goulash helps feed a town under strain. Chef Breanna fed the active Stormwind garrison during the recent Blackrock orc uprising, emptying her pantry and leaving her to seek hearty ingredients from the mountains.

sections.title: A Bare Mountain Pantry
sections.body: Lakeshire remains under siege from Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and ferocious wild beasts. When the recent orc uprising began along the ridges, Chef Breanna took on feeding the entire brigade of Stormwind troops stationed in town. Keeping the active garrison fed quickly emptied her cupboards, though the town still had plenty of hungry mouths.

sections.title: Mountain Bounty
sections.body: With her cupboards bare, Chef Breanna looks to the dangerous wilderness beyond Lakeshire's gates. Her signature goulash calls for tough mountain condor meat, seasoned snouts from formidable Great Goretusks, and crisp leg meat from giant tarantulas that prowl the hills.

faq.q: Why is Chef Breanna out of food supplies?
faq.answer: During the recent Blackrock orc uprising, Chef Breanna fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops stationed to defend Lakeshire. Keeping the active garrison supplied emptied her cupboards.

faq.q: What ingredients are used to make Redridge Goulash?
faq.answer: Redridge Goulash calls for five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts, and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat, gathered from creatures in the surrounding mountains.
Chef Breanna tends her hearth and cooking kettles in Lakeshire, along the northern shores of Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why doesn't Lakeshire just import food from Stormwind City?
faq.answer: Orcs, Blackrock raiders, and gnolls choke the mountain passes, while Stormwind's resources are stretched thin. Lakeshire often depends on local wildlife and visiting adventurers for food.

faq.q: Is Redridge Goulash considered a delicacy?
faq.answer: Chef Breanna and Lakeshire's frontier folk consider the finished dish a hearty mountain delicacy, though its spider meat, boar snouts, and leathery condor flesh may sound harsh to outsiders.

faq.q: What brigade did Breanna have to feed?
faq.answer: Chef Breanna cooked for the Stormwind soldiers stationed in Lakeshire to push back the Blackrock orc forces pressing down from the northern ridges.

angles.text: As a cook exploring the Eastern Kingdoms, you can see how Chef Breanna turns fierce mountain beasts into sustaining, savory fare.
As an Alliance member, you can see how the Blackrock orc invasion has strained Lakeshire's stores, garrisons, and civilian life.
